"The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, and the Lord will by no means clear the guilty." How do God's patience and justice go together?
"The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; he knows those who take refuge in him." How has God been your stronghold?
"Behold, upon the mountains, the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace!" How can you bring good news?
"The Lord is restoring the majesty of Jacob." What does God's restoring work mean to you?
God says, "Behold, I am against you." What does it mean when God stands against cruelty?
Nineveh was a city of bloodshed and lies. What does God think of violence and deceit?
All who hear of Nineveh's fall clap their hands, for who had not felt its cruelty? Why is God's justice good news for the oppressed?
